⇒ objectui#9846 did ⛔ not touch it. **The card stands, and no second repair route is being opened.**

## ⭐⭐ The dependency this card was filed with is now SATISFIED — ⛔ no `Blocked-by:` is owed

When this card was filed at 2026-09-18T09:34Z its body asked for a body-anchored `Blocked-by: objectui#7181`, because moving a producer to `children` was **unsafe** while the two vscode readers resolved `schema.body` alone: a `children`-spelled `pages/NAME.json` got a **silently blank** preview and children that were never validated.

**PR objectui#9846 merged 2026-09-18T10:58:33Z** and those readers are on `origin/main` now — `schema.children || schema.body` resolves **2×** in each of `providers/PreviewProvider.ts` and `providers/SchemaValidator.ts`. ⇒ the reason for the block is gone; triage never added the line, and none is owed. Recorded here so the next reader does not re-derive it from the card's own body.

## ⚠️ THE HANDOFF THIS CARD MUST COMPLETE — and it is the point of the card

`scripts/__tests__/body-dialect-census.test.ts:293` asserts, today:

```ts
expect(readCode('packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts')).toMatch(/^\s*body:/m);
```

⇒ **this card's fix will RED that pin**, by design. objectui#7181's repair round wrote the handoff into the block's own comment: the block's claim is 「the platform SHIPS the dialect it is being asked to refuse」, and it must be re-pointed at 「whatever still ships the dialect — or at **nothing**, once nothing does, **which is the day objectui#6771 step 4 becomes landable**」.

⭐ **This card is that day, if the census agrees.** So the deliverable is not only the one-line migration; it is:
1. re-run `pnpm census:body-dialect` and establish whether `generate.ts` was the **last** producer;
2. re-point that block accordingly, keeping its **ordering rationale** intact;
3. ⛔ **do not** invert it into a tautology asserting this branch's own diff back at itself — objectui#7181's repair refused exactly that and the reason is in the block.

⚠️ If the census shows an **eighth** producer, triage's escalation clause fires and it is ⛔ not this seat's: 「测到**第八个**生产者 ⇒ ⛔ 不再逐个立卡,改为『让这张生产者表由**扫描**而不是由**枚举**产生』—— 那时问题不是『还剩几个』,而是『这张表凭什么是完整的』。」 **Stop and report** if that happens; do ⛔ not file a ninth card.

## ⛔ Out of scope

⛔ `packages/vscode-extension/src/providers/**` — landed, nothing to do. ⛔ `packages/types/src/base.ts` and its zod mirror — objectui#6771 step 3. ⛔ Corpus and teaching — step 5. ⛔ objectui#6771's step list itself. ⛔ The six producers objectui#7181 already moved.

## Serial constraints cleared, read at 2026-09-18T11:02Z

12 `domain:ui` cards are `pm:dispatched` across all seats; ⛔ none is inside `packages/cli/src/commands/`. Seat 1's in-flight PR objectui#9803 touches `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` — same package, **different file**. ⭐ And both of this seat's own PRs merged at 2026-09-18T10:58:33Z, so ⛔ nothing is in flight on `packages/cli` or on `scripts/__tests__/`.

## Reading discipline

Every zero needs a same-subject control firing **in the same command**. Resolve refs before grepping. ⛔ Print LINES, never a bare count, when a count is the evidence. ⚠️ Two shapes this lane has measured repeatedly and that both bite on this exact file family: a code-shaped pattern gives a **false zero or a false count** against a regex literal, a loop variable, a `const` declaration, spacing, or non-code text inside a template string — `init.ts`'s `<body>`/`</body>` HTML tags produced this card's family's own 53-vs-55 story; and ⭐ a source-text assertion over a file that **documents** the construct it asserts on will **pass off the comment** — measured on `providers/SchemaValidator.ts`, invisible to the assertion's own result, caught only by ablation. The census test already carries a `readCode` helper for the second; use it.
